claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the sofa’s appearance (color, 2-seater, tufted/stitched look) and does not show usage duration.
Witness report does not include measurements or a scale; only general appearance is described.
No brand/model label or purchase proof is visible in the witness report.
Witness report does not mention close-up inspection of upholstery for stains.
Witness report does not show damage close-ups (rips/tears).
Firmness/foam condition cannot be confirmed from the single described photo view.
No evidence of odor/smoke exposure is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Upholstery condition issues not visible in the single image (hidden stains, small tears, burns, or worn fabric seams).
risks.proof: One clear close-up video/clip of the entire seat, both armrests, and all seams from multiple angles under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used sofa with unknown upholstery condition (worst-case: possible minor stains/tears).

risks.risk: Cushion/foam sagging or weak springs (firmness claim can’t be verified remotely).
risks.proof: Short clip showing the seller pressing down on the seat cushions and releasing them (showing rebound), plus a side view of cushion thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed firm/possible sagging (worst-case: needs re-padding).

risks.risk: Frame problems (wobble, broken springs, loose joints) not detectable from the described photo.
risks.proof: Video clip where the sofa is gently rocked at the corners and the underside/legs are shown for looseness or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown structural integrity (worst-case: minor frame/spring issues).

risks.risk: Material type and quality (fabric vs leather vs faux leather) affects durability and cleaning cost.
risks.proof: Close-up macro shots of the upholstery texture and edges, plus a photo of the underside/back where material is clearer.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic fabric upholstery of unknown quality (worst-case: lower-grade material).

risks.risk: Size mismatch (seller says over 4 feet long, but no measurement is shown).
risks.proof: Photo with a measuring tape along the sofa length (armrest to armrest) and width/height.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard 2-seater with uncertain dimensions (worst-case: smaller than expected).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (pillows, covers) or non-standard features (recline/bed function) that change value.
risks.proof: Full layout video showing all sides, back, and any attachments; confirm whether any cushions/pillows are included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic 2-seater with no included accessories/features beyond what’s visible.

proof_requests: Send a measuring-tape photo for length (armrest to armrest), seat depth, and overall height.
Send close-up photos of upholstery seams and corners (front seat, both armrests, back cushions) under bright light.
Send a short video pressing down on the cushions to demonstrate rebound/firmness.
Send a video rocking the sofa gently and showing the legs/underside for wobble or damage.
Send clear photos of the material texture (fabric vs leather/faux leather) and the underside/back for quality cues.
Confirm and show whether any pillows/covers are included and whether there are any hidden functions (recline/bed).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a 2-seater sofa, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller claims about cleanliness, firmness, and dimensions are not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume unknown condition until proof is provided.
